notes.title: Monument Valley 3 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h2][b]Monument Valley 3 is officially OUT NOW on Steam![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][i]Launch discount of 10% available until 5th August 2025.[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p]Dear Monument Valley 2 fans - we're excited to share news of the newest instalment in the series![/p][p]Experience Monument Valley 3 with cinematic widescreen, stunning art design and impossible landscapes, all fully playable with gamepad or keyboard and mouse.
[/p][p]Noor must seek out a new source of light before darkness overtakes her world. Guide her through sprawling cities, coastal harbours, and abstract, ethereal realms.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]More content planned for Monument Valley 3, later this year[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/a0f6e3b9f553b782be78f75fb96e2267384ff770.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to let you know that we will be releasing more content for Monument Valley 3 later this year. We will release this content - The Garden of Life - [b]free for all players[/b]. [/p][p]More information to be shared with you soon![/p][p][/p][h2][b]3% of Profits Will Go to Flood Relief Programmes[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/96a2068a0f005e2b3518cadcd814569cb4bb3450.png"][/img][/p][p]As a reminder, 3% of all profits generated by Monument Valley 3 will be donated to flood relief programmes by the IFRC. [/p][p]As the rainy season begins in places such as South America and devastating floods continue to impact communities, we’re deeply grateful to our players - your support is helping deliver clean water, sanitation and support to families in need. Thank you.
[/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Controller Support is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465049/a59864a84ce9f550550d9224f23071180d938d05.gif[/img]

Hey everyone,

It’s been a while but we’ve got some exciting news.

[h3][i]Monument Valley[/i] and [i]Monument Valley 2[/i] now have [b]full controller support! [/b][/h3]

Whether you’re relaxing with a gamepad on the couch or just prefer the tactile feel of analog sticks, you can now guide Ida and Ro through their journeys with your controller of choice.

[b]We are also delighted to announce that the games are now Steam Deck Verified![/b]

This update is available to all players on Steam. Just update your game and you’re good to go!

We’re always listening and looking for ways to improve your experience, and we know controller support has been a popular request. We hope this makes your time in these beautiful worlds even more seamless and enjoyable.

As always, thank you for your support - and if you’ve been meaning to replay the games or introduce them to someone new, now’s a great time.

Your friends,

[i]ustwo games[/i]

notes.title: Monument Valley: Panoramic Editions 1 + 2 coming soon - wishlist now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465055/e8abd6a5505856b86868f5be7e27306eba9d0f99.png[/img]

[h2]Kicking off our ‘summer of ustwo games'; we are incredibly proud to present an entirely new way to play one of our most beloved titles, right here on Steam. [/h2]

[h3]Introducing… Monument Valley: Panoramic Collection[/h3]

Our Panoramic Collection consists of two brand new game releases from us -

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927720/Monument_Valley_Panoramic_Edition]Monument Valley: Panoramic Edition [/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927740/Monument_Valley_2_Panoramic_Edition]Monument Valley 2: Panoramic Edition [/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/9753427/sale/MonumentValleyPC]VISIT THE SALE PAGE HERE![/url]

Together, these editions create our Panoramic Collection. Built exclusively for PC and ultra-wide displays, these editions are reimagined from the ground up for keyboard and mouse/touchpad support, and feature every single world, add-on and DLC ever lovingly made. 

For some longtime fans of ours, you might be asking - [i]‘but why now?’ [/i]

And it’s a good question. [b]Here at ustwo games, we have never stopped loving Monument Valley[/b] - it's so important to who we are, and to this day, helps us drive forward as a studio with unity. What was initially an experiment quickly ended up becoming something more.

Now, we are excited about the opportunity to open up and expand the world of Monument Valley without any restrictions - this is the widest, richest, and most beautiful version of Monument Valley you can ever play. 

Thanks to everyone who has ever played, recommended, and shown Monument Valley to their friends and family and made Monument Valley grow into a world bigger than we ever could have imagined. Here’s to the world of illusions always expanding.

See you on 12 July. 

Your friends,

[b]ustwo games[/b]
